name: gphone
description: An open-source TypeScript phone for FiveM

scripts.build: pnpm clearbuild && pnpm typecheck && node build/build-bundle.js && pnpm build:web
scripts.build:web: cd web && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.watch: pnpm clearbuild && cross-env IS_WATCH_MODE=1 node build/build-bundle.js

author: mbiddle
